entry.en: Greece applies Schengen rules, so your passport must expire at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area.
entry.es: Grecia aplica las normas Schengen, así que tu pasaporte debe vencer al menos 3 meses después del día en que planeas salir del espacio Schengen.
entry.quote: have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area

entry.en: You may also need to show a return or onward ticket.
entry.es: Es posible que también debas mostrar un billete de vuelta o de continuación.
entry.quote: show a return or onward ticket

entry.en: Cash or travellers cheques worth 10,000 euros or more must be declared on entry to Greece.
entry.es: El efectivo o los cheques de viaje por valor de 10.000 euros o más deben declararse al entrar en Grecia.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques at your point of entry into Greece if you are carrying a value of 10,000 euros or more.

entry.en: You cannot take meat, milk or products containing them into EU countries, with a few exceptions.
entry.es: No se puede llevar carne, leche ni productos que las contengan a países de la UE, con algunas excepciones.
entry.quote: You cannot take meat, milk or products containing them into EU countries.

entry.en: On short stays in the Schengen area you may need to register biometric details such as fingerprints and a photo.
entry.es: En estancias cortas en el espacio Schengen puede que tengas que registrar datos biométricos como huellas dactilares y una foto.
entry.quote: when you travel into the Schengen area for short stays, you may need to register your biometric details, such as fingerprints and a photo.

safety.en: Thefts of passports, wallets and handbags are common on the metro and in crowded tourist places, particularly in central Athens.
safety.es: Los robos de pasaportes, carteras y bolsos son comunes en el metro y en lugares turísticos concurridos, sobre todo en el centro de Atenas.
safety.quote: Thefts of passports, wallets and handbags are common on the metro and in crowded tourist places, particularly in central Athens.

safety.en: There is a high risk of wildfires during the summer season from April to October.
safety.es: Hay un alto riesgo de incendios forestales durante la temporada de verano, de abril a octubre.
safety.quote: There is a high risk of wildfires during the summer season from April to October.

safety.en: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Greece.
safety.es: Es probable que los terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Grecia.
safety.quote: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Greece.

safety.en: Regular strikes, sometimes called at short notice, can disrupt buses, trains, ferries, flights, roads and borders.
safety.es: Hay huelgas frecuentes, a veces convocadas con poco aviso, que pueden afectar a autobuses, trenes, ferris, vuelos, carreteras y fronteras.
safety.quote: There are regular strikes, sometimes called at short notice, that can cause disruption to buses, trains, ferries and air travel, as well as road networks and borders.

safety.en: Demonstrations often take place around major squares in central Athens, in particular Syntagma Square.
safety.es: Las manifestaciones suelen celebrarse en las plazas principales del centro de Atenas, en particular la plaza Syntagma.
safety.quote: Demonstrations often take place around major squares in central Athens, in particular Syntagma Square.

safety.en: Traffic can be busy, fast and chaotic, especially in the larger cities.
safety.es: El tráfico puede ser intenso, rápido y caótico, especialmente en las ciudades grandes.
safety.quote: Traffic can be busy, fast and chaotic, especially in the larger cities.

health.en: Treatment and facilities are generally good on the mainland but may be limited on the islands.
health.es: El tratamiento y las instalaciones son por lo general buenos en el continente, pero pueden ser limitados en las islas.
health.quote: Treatment and facilities are generally good on the mainland, but may be limited on the islands.

health.en: Pharmacies stock a good supply of medicines, but there are strict rules for dispensing certain ones, including antibiotics.
health.es: Las farmacias tienen buen surtido de medicamentos, pero hay normas estrictas para dispensar algunos, incluidos los antibióticos.
health.quote: Pharmacies across Greece stock a good supply of medicines, but there are strict rules around dispensing certain medicines, including antibiotics.

health.en: Bring prescription medicines and carry a letter from your doctor stating the quantity needed for your stay.
health.es: Lleva tus medicamentos recetados y una carta de tu médico que indique la cantidad necesaria para tu estancia.
health.quote: Bring prescription medicines with you and carry a letter from your doctor stating the quantity required during your stay.

health.en: Public health care is free for EU nationals who present an EHIC card, while non-EU nationals get only emergency care for free.
health.es: La atención pública es gratuita para los nacionales de la UE con tarjeta EHIC; los de fuera de la UE solo reciben gratis la atención de urgencia.
health.quote: public health care is free and universal for all citizens, and for all EU nationals upon presentation of an EHIC card (formerly the E111 form). For non-EU nationals, only emergency care is provided for free.

health.en: Dial 112 or 166 and ask for an ambulance.
health.es: Marca el 112 o el 166 y pide una ambulancia.
health.quote: Dial 112 or 166 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: Sun and heat pose risks that summer visitors should take precautions for.
health.es: El sol y el calor suponen riesgos ante los que los visitantes de verano deben tomar precauciones.
health.quote: Sun and heat pose risks that summer visitors should take precautions for.

help.en: The emergency number in Greece is 112 for ambulance, fire and police.
help.es: El número de emergencias en Grecia es el 112 para ambulancia, bomberos y policía.

help.en: Contact your travel provider and your insurer if you are involved in a serious incident or emergency abroad.
help.es: Contacta con tu proveedor de viaje y tu aseguradora si te ves envuelto en un incidente grave o una emergencia en el extranjero.
help.quote: Contact your travel provider and your insurer if you are involved in a serious incident or emergency abroad.

getting_in.en: Athens International Airport is the country's largest and busiest airport and its main hub.
getting_in.es: El Aeropuerto Internacional de Atenas es el mayor y más concurrido del país y su principal centro de conexiones.
getting_in.quote: Athens International Airport in Athens is the country's largest, busiest airport and main hub

getting_in.en: Thessaloniki Airport is also served year-round by direct flights from all over Europe.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Tesalónica también recibe vuelos directos de toda Europa durante todo el año.
getting_in.quote: Thessaloniki Airport "Macedonia" in Thessaloniki is also served year-round by direct flights from all over Europe.

getting_in.en: During the winter season, the Greek islands can be reached only by domestic flights via Athens.
getting_in.es: Durante el invierno, a las islas griegas solo se llega con vuelos nacionales vía Atenas.
getting_in.quote: During the winter season, the Greek islands can be reached only by domestic flights via Athens.

getting_in.en: As of 2022, there are no long-distance international passenger train services to Greece.
getting_in.es: En 2022 no hay servicios ferroviarios internacionales de larga distancia de pasajeros hacia Grecia.
getting_in.quote: As of 2022, there are no long-distance international passenger services to Greece.

getting_in.en: International buses run mostly from Thessaloniki, with some companies also starting routes from Athens.
getting_in.es: Los autobuses internacionales salen sobre todo de Tesalónica, y algunas empresas también desde Atenas.
getting_in.quote: There is an international bus service in Greece mostly from Thessaloniki, with some companies also having routes starting from Athens.

getting_in.en: Ferries carry cars and passengers from Italy to Greece.
getting_in.es: Hay ferris que transportan coches y pasajeros de Italia a Grecia.
getting_in.quote: From Italy, ferries will transport cars and passengers to Greece

getting_around.en: KTEL is the national intercity bus network, with a dense route system serving almost the entire country.
getting_around.es: KTEL es la red nacional de autobuses interurbanos, con un denso sistema de rutas que cubre casi todo el país.
getting_around.quote: KTEL is the national government-subsidized network of independent businesses which cooperate together to form a dense route system serving almost the entire country.

getting_around.en: The railway system is very underdeveloped, with most rail traffic in the Athens - Thessaloniki corridor.
getting_around.es: La red ferroviaria está muy poco desarrollada y la mayor parte del tráfico está en el corredor Atenas - Tesalónica.
getting_around.quote: The railway system in Greece is very underdeveloped compared to other European countries and most of the rail traffic is in the Athens - Thessaloniki corridor

getting_around.en: The Greek ferry system is basically hub-and-spoke, with routes radiating from Piraeus to the island groups.
getting_around.es: El sistema de ferris griego es básicamente de eje y radios, con rutas que parten del Pireo hacia los grupos de islas.
getting_around.quote: The Greek ferry system is basically a hub-and-spoke system, with the spokes radiating from Piraeus out to the various island groups.

getting_around.en: In the January to March off-season, rough Aegean weather often keeps boats in port for days.
getting_around.es: En la temporada baja de enero a marzo, el mal tiempo en el Egeo suele mantener los barcos en puerto durante días.
getting_around.quote: during the winter off-season (January to March), the weather on the Aegean can be extremely rough and boats are often kept in port for days at a time.

getting_around.en: Drivers without an EU driving licence must carry an international driver's permit from their home country.
getting_around.es: Los conductores sin licencia de la UE deben llevar un permiso de conducir internacional de su país.
getting_around.quote: Drivers who do not hold an EU driving licence must carry an international driver's permit obtained in their home country.

getting_around.en: About 90% of rental cars are manual, so reserve an automatic in advance.
getting_around.es: Cerca del 90% de los coches de alquiler son manuales, por lo que conviene reservar uno automático con antelación.
getting_around.quote: About 90% of rental cars are manual, for automatics it is advised to reserve one in advance.

money.quote: Greece uses the euro, like several other European countries.

money.en: ATMs are almost everywhere, and MasterCard/Cirrus and Visa/Plus are the most widely accepted cards.
money.es: Hay cajeros casi en todas partes y las tarjetas más aceptadas son MasterCard/Cirrus y Visa/Plus.
money.quote: ATMs are present almost everywhere, with MasterCard/Cirrus and Visa/Plus being the most widely accepted cards.

money.en: Many ATMs may not accept 5-digit PINs, so change yours to 4 digits before leaving home.
money.es: Muchos cajeros pueden no aceptar PIN de 5 dígitos, por lo que conviene cambiarlo a 4 dígitos antes de viajar.
money.quote: Many ATM machines may not accept 5-digit pin numbers; ATM card-users with 5-digit pins are advised to change their pin to 4 digits before leaving home.

money.en: Cards are widely accepted in shops, hotels and travel agencies, but not in some restaurants.
money.es: Las tarjetas se aceptan ampliamente en tiendas, hoteles y agencias de viajes, pero no en algunos restaurantes.
money.quote: are widely accepted across the country in retail stores, hotels, and travel/transportation agencies (including ferry, airline, and car rental agencies), but are not accepted in some restaurants.

money.en: Many businesses are reluctant to accept notes larger than 50 euros.
money.es: Muchos comercios son reacios a aceptar billetes de más de 50 euros.
money.quote: Many businesses are reluctant to accept notes of larger than €50

money.en: Traditionally, tipping in restaurants is not customary in Greece.
money.es: Tradicionalmente, dejar propina en los restaurantes no es costumbre en Grecia.
money.quote: Traditionally tipping in restaurants is not customary in Greece.

etiquette.en: Greeks generally consider it proper etiquette to let the stranger make the first move.
etiquette.es: Los griegos suelen considerar de buena educación dejar que el desconocido dé el primer paso.
etiquette.quote: Greeks generally consider it proper etiquette to let the stranger make the first move.

etiquette.en: Church dress codes sometimes include covered shoulders for women and covered knees for both sexes.
etiquette.es: Los códigos de vestimenta en iglesias a veces exigen hombros cubiertos para las mujeres y rodillas cubiertas para ambos sexos.
etiquette.quote: Dress codes for churches sometimes include covered shoulders for women and knees covered for both sexes

etiquette.en: Nudity is not common in public, and topless is not accepted outside tourist areas.
etiquette.es: La desnudez no es común en público y el topless no se acepta fuera de las zonas turísticas.
etiquette.quote: Nudity is not so common in the Greek public. Also topless is not accepted outside the tourist areas.

etiquette.en: Avoid calling Greece a Balkan country, as Greeks generally dislike this label.
etiquette.es: Evita decir que Grecia es un país balcánico, ya que a los griegos en general no les gusta esa etiqueta.
etiquette.quote: Avoid saying that Greece is a Balkan country; Greeks generally dislike this label.

etiquette.en: Never say or imply that a Greek person is untrustworthy or unreliable, as this is considered insulting.
etiquette.es: Nunca digas ni insinúes que un griego no es de fiar, porque se considera un insulto.
etiquette.quote: Never say or imply that a Greek person is untrustworthy or unreliable; this is considered insulting.

etiquette.en: Respect for elders is very important in Greece.
etiquette.es: El respeto a los mayores es muy importante en Grecia.
etiquette.quote: Respect for elders is very important in Greece.

connectivity.en: Cosmote, Wind and Vodafone are the main mobile carriers and by law require identification to activate a prepaid plan.
connectivity.es: Cosmote, Wind y Vodafone son los operadores móviles principales y por ley exigen identificación para activar un plan de prepago.
connectivity.quote: There are at least three mobile carriers, Cosmote, Wind and Vodafone all of which require by law presenting some form of identification in order to activate your prepaid plan.

connectivity.en: There are no internet roaming charges for EU citizens using their own SIM card in Greece.
connectivity.es: No hay cargos de roaming de internet para ciudadanos de la UE que usen su propia SIM en Grecia.
connectivity.quote: There are no Internet roaming charges for EU citizens, so you can surf the Internet in Greece as normal with your local sim card.

connectivity.en: Almost all hotels provide internet access, either free or paid.
connectivity.es: Casi todos los hoteles ofrecen acceso a internet, gratuito o de pago.
connectivity.quote: Almost all hotels provide internet access, either free or paid.

connectivity.en: Local coffee shops usually offer free Wi-Fi, as do many other public places.
connectivity.es: Las cafeterías locales suelen ofrecer wifi gratis, igual que muchos otros lugares públicos.
connectivity.quote: Local coffee shops usually offer free Wi-Fi access, as many other public places do.
